text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card (27.4% of 1,042, expected 2.2%, z 3.79, 66% low complexity, 44 records, 15 of 23, 17% comparison). Cited claims fit their sentences: the three below-billed 99215 examples show moderate MDM and the three low-complexity examples match card rows. Language is cautious (\"reason to review, not a finding\"). Next steps are concrete (request charts, coder re-score, sampling caution, audit trail). Weaknesses: the \"problems 39%\" note-check figures are not explained or visible on the card, and the rationale lists several zero-rate signs that add noise. The three low-complexity examples do not show how diagnoses and the visit-level mismatch reveal anything beyond age and condition counts. The summary omits mention of the 4 supported 99215 claims, which would give balance, and gives no missing-data caveat such as the small 4% documented share (44 of 1,042) and possible selection of records. Next steps cite only the below-billed claims, not the low-complexity ones, so those examples are not tied to an action.","problems":["Note-check percentages (problems 39%, late 7%) are not on the card and lack explanation; zero-rate items add clutter","No caveat that only 4.2% of claims have documentation, so the 65% rests on a small, possibly non-random subset","Low-complexity example claims are not tied to any next step; no mention of supported 99215 claims for balance","Headline stresses documentation mismatch but the summary does not weigh the 'no lab on claim' flag meaningfully (1 of 33)"]}
